Battle of Austerlitz

Date2 December 1805

The Battle of Austerlitz was fought on 2 December 1805.[1]

Prelude

Kutuzov could call upon some 110,000 men in the theatre, but many never reached the field.

The battle

Napoleon directed the battle in person while Soult stormed the Pratzen Heights.
